DZA.note: Nothing stated on government AI use.
Cluster is for startups; no AI model, dataset or computing is stated.

facts.fact: We Are Tech reports a government strategy to scale up the entrepreneurial ecosystem, with President Tebboune's target of 20,000 start-ups in Algeria by 2029.
Authorities reported Algeria had registered 130 start-ups and 1,175 projects labeled as innovative.

Algeria launched its first national AI and cybersecurity start-up cluster on 18 April 2026 at the Sidi Abdellah science and technology hub in Algiers, backed by the Higher Education, Knowledge Economy and Telecommunications ministries; no cohort is named.
